name: trade.glitterchainscout.agents/agent-gate
title: Glitter Agent Gate (x402)
description: Pay-per-call agent tools (web to Markdown, XRPL data, file conversion) via x402 in XRP or RLUSD.

environmentVariables.name: XRPL_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Seed of a dedicated low-balance agent wallet that pays per call. Never use a main wallet.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOW_MAINNET
environmentVariables.description: Must be 'true' to pay on XRPL mainnet (real funds).

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Optional override. Default: the network the gateway advertises (production = xrpl:0 mainnet).

environmentVariables.name: SESSION_BUDGET_XRP
environmentVariables.description: Total XRP the server may spend per session
